title: VoxelClient
description: This is the offical modrinth page for the voxelclient
body:
# VoxelClient > A Fabric client mod for Minecraft 1.21.4 with a custom HUD, zoom, freelook, cosmetics, utility features, and many quality-of-life improvements. --- ## 📥 Installation ### Automatic (recommended) 1. **Download the installer** → [Releases](https://github.com/VoxelLabs-Minecraft/voxelclient-installer/releases) 2. Run `voxelclient-installer.exe` 3. Select your desired `mods/` folder (detected automatically) 4. Click **"Install Now"** 5. Launch Minecraft with the **Fabric Launcher** The installer automatically downloads the latest version and the required **Fabric API**. --- ### Manual 1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/installer) ≥ 0.16 2. Download [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) 3. Download the latest `voxelclient-x.x.x.jar` from [Releases](https://github.com/VoxelLabs-Minecraft/voxelclient/releases/latest) 4. Place both `.jar` files in `.minecraft/mods/` 5. Launch Minecraft 1.21.4 --- # ✦ Features ## 📊 Custom HUD A clean, customizable in-game display: - FPS Counter - XYZ Coordinates - Facing Direction - Armor Display - Speedometer - Ping Display (color-coded) - CPS Counter (LMB / RMB) - Keystrokes Overlay (WASD, SPACE, LMB, RMB) All HUD elements can be freely repositioned. --- ## 🖱️ HUD Editor Under **Settings → UI → HUD Editor** you can: - Drag and drop all HUD elements - Save positions permanently - Customize the layout individually Saved to: ``voxelclient/hud_position.json`` All UI screens also feature a modern **Fade + Slide Animation (250ms, easeOutCubic)**. --- ## 🎮 Gameplay Features ### 🏃 Toggle Sprint Keep sprint permanently active (default: `R`). Disables automatically when stopping. ### 🕵️ Toggle Sneak Keep sneak permanently active (key configurable). ### 🧭 Snap Look Snaps your camera to the nearest 45° angle: N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW (Key configurable) --- ## 🔍 Smooth Zoom Smooth zoom-in with a cinematic easing effect. Fine-tune zoom strength with the scroll wheel. **Default key:** `C` --- ## 👁️ Freelook Rotate the camera independently of the player model — ideal for PvP, exploration, and cinematics. **Default key:** `Left Alt` --- ## 📍 Waypoint System Save and manage waypoints directly in-game. - Create & delete waypoints - Direction indicator on screen edge - Manage under **Settings → Utility → Waypoints** Saved to: ``voxelclient/waypoints.json`` ### ☠ Death Waypoint A waypoint is automatically created upon death: - Saves coordinates + timestamp - Up to 10 death waypoints stored --- ## 🛡️ Armor Durability Warning - Shows durability of all armor pieces - 🟠 Orange below 50% - 🔴 Red below 20% --- ## 📊 CPS Counter Shows clicks per second for: - LMB - RMB Based on a 1-second sliding window. --- ## 🌐 Ping Display Shows current server ping: - 🟢 Green < 50ms - 🟡 Medium - 🔴 Red > 300ms --- ## ⌨️ Keystrokes Overlay Animated display of: - W, A, S, D - SPACE - LMB - RMB Default position: bottom right Freely movable in the HUD Editor. --- ## 💬 Chat Timestamps Automatically prepends a timestamp to every message: ``[HH:mm] Message`` --- ## 🎭 Cosmetics Load your own cape via any PNG URL. The cape is loaded asynchronously without delaying game startup. --- ## ✦ Player Badges A badge appears before every player name: - **Gray** `✦` → regular player - **Dark Red** `✦` → VoxelClient Creator Visible in: - The tab list - Above the player's head --- ## ⚙️ Settings GUI A modern in-game menu with tab navigation. - All features configurable - JSON-based storage - Utility, UI, and Gameplay sections **Default key:** `Right Shift` --- ## 🔔 Auto-Updater Automatically checks for a new version on startup. - Golden banner on the main menu - Direct link to the download page - Press `U` to open the update page --- ## 🎮 Discord Rich Presence Shows your current status in Discord: - Main Menu - Singleplayer - Multiplayer - Realms Server logos are displayed automatically. --- # ⌨️ Keybinds (Default) | Function | Key | |----------|-----| | Open Settings | `Right Shift` | | Zoom | `C` (hold) | | Freelook | `Left Alt` (hold) | | Toggle Sprint | `R` | | Open Update Page | `U` | | Snap Look | configurable | | Toggle Sneak | configurable | All keys can be freely remapped under **Minecraft → Options → Controls → VoxelClient** --- # 📋 Requirements | What | Version | |------|---------| | Minecraft | 1.21.4 | | Fabric Loader | ≥ 0.16 | | Fabric API | 1.21.4 | | Java | 21+ | --- # 🏗️ Build It Yourself ```bash git clone https://github.com/VoxelLabs-Minecraft/voxelclient.git cd voxelclient ./gradlew build # → build/libs/voxelclient-x.x.x.jar ``` Run the client directly: ```bash ./gradlew runClient ``` --- # 📄 License MIT License — see https://github.com/VoxelLabs-Minecraft/voxelclient/blob/main/LICENSE.txt ---
